name: Default
shortDescription: Open source CRM for sales, marketing and customer service, with a MariaDB database and an automatic first-run install.

alerts.message: The first visit to the site runs the installer, which takes a minute or two; keep the page open until it finishes. Then log in as admin with the password from the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable. Editing that variable later does not change the password; change it in SuiteCRM instead.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
